name: Ambato
discoveryMethod: First-party English and Ecuadorian Spanish discovery, municipal custodian review, and bounded anonymous ArcGIS REST metadata/query inspection.
queryOutcomes: Both discovery languages identified the same official GAD Municipalidad de Ambato cadastral directorate, municipal Geoportal, and ArcGIS cadastral service. Indexed first-party metadata was available, but direct anonymous layer and bounded query requests returned an application error stating that no server machines could be accessed. No parcel geometry or attributes were retained.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: GAD Municipalidad de Ambato, Dirección de Catastros y Avalúos; official page assigns urban/rural cadastral administration, cartography, and municipal GIS responsibilities.
sourceAssessment.publicService: Official municipal ArcGIS REST service Moviles/CATASTROFISICO, layer SDE.AMBATO_PREDIAL (ID 1), documented in indexed first-party metadata as a polygon layer in EPSG:32717.
sourceAssessment.nativeFieldsObserved: OBJECTID, ID_CATASTR, and other cadastral fields were visible in metadata; only OBJECTID/ID_CATASTR were considered safe identity candidates. No source attributes were retained.
sourceAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: ZONA, SECTOR, MANZANA, and PREDIO are exposed, but no composite identity was constructed because no feature response was obtained.
